title: Scaling the extended-exponent uniform norm
statement: For a finite nonempty set $\Omega$, an extended nonnegative real exponent $q\ne 0$, a real number $c$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the extended-exponent uniform norm of $x\mapsto c f(x)$ equals $|c|$ times that of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is an extended nonnegative real and $q\ne0$
